criteria.evidence: All four clauses fail at head. (1) 'JSX event props must not contain inline arrow/function expressions': `node scripts/check-named-handlers.mjs` reports 1474 inline closures in JSX event props at head, and the gate deliberately does not enforce the literal clause — its own header (scripts/check-named-handlers.mjs:5-10) states 'Enforced literally that is 1,461 occurrences... This gate enforces the word the box itself uses, NON-TRIVIAL.' That is the C044 rule, not the C046 rule; the criterion as written is unenforced and unmet. (2) 'no meaningless handler-to-handler chains': 10 measured at frontend/features/build/shared/filter-command-menu.tsx:267-276 — `handleToggleStatus`, `handleTogglePriority`, `handleToggleType`, `handleToggleAssignee`, `handleToggleLabel`, `handleToggleCycle`, `handleToggleSprint`, `handleToggleProject`, `handleDueDateFromChange`, `handleDueDateToChange`, each `useCallback((v: string) => { onX(v); }, [onX])` — a second identity over a prop that is already a named callback. (3) 'useCallback only when referential identity affects memoization, subscription or effect correctness': frontend/components/assistant/persona-chip-strip.tsx:34 wraps `handleClick` in useCallback whose only consumer is `onClick` on an intrinsic `<button>` — React attaches DOM listeners regardless of identity, so the memoization provably buys nothing; the same shape recurs across the codebase. (4) 'verify every dependency': frontend/eslint.config.mjs:19 sets `react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` to 'warn', and package.json defines `lint` as bare `eslint` with no `--max-warnings`, so a wrong dependency array can never fail a build.
criteria.blocker: Either amend C046 to the non-trivial rule the gate actually implements (and say so in the PRD), or hoist the 1474 inline closures; delete the ten filter-command-menu wrappers; drop useCallback where the only consumer is an intrinsic tag; set exhaustive-deps to 'error' or add --max-warnings 0.
criteria.clauses_failing: all four: no inline closures in JSX event props (1474); no meaningless handler chains (10); useCallback only where identity matters; verify every dependency (rule is a non-blocking warning)
